meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning skill. Self-orchestrates 5 hostile category members (unspecified-low, unspecified-high, deep, ultrabrain, artistry) via team-mode for ruthless cross-critique debate, distills only the defensible insights, then MANDATORILY hands the distilled insight bundle to the `plan` agent for executable plan formalization. Use when planning needs maximum rigor and surfacing of weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering. Triggers: 'hyperplan', 'hpp', '/hyperplan', 'adversarial plan', 'hostile planning', 'cross-critique plan', '하이퍼플랜', '적대적 계획', '교차 비평'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用多智能体对抗辩论提炼规划洞察，生成可执行方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在规划时暴露弱假设并避免盲点
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to surface weak assumptions and blind spots in your planning process

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会当对抗式规划团队的队长：召集5个互相挑刺的成员辩论计划，只保留经得起攻击的结论，再强制交给 plan 智能体写成可执行方案。
howto.when: 当你说出“hyperplan”“hpp”或“/hyperplan”等触发词，或要求对抗式/交叉批评规划时触发。

say.text: 用 hyperplan 帮我做项目规划
say.note: Claude 会启动5人对抗团队辩论审查

say.text: 对这个计划做一次敌对式批评
say.note: 5个成员互相攻击，只保留可辩护的结论

say.text: hpp：检查我的方案有没有盲点和过度设计
say.note: 结论会交给 plan 智能体形成正式计划

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude acts as the lead of an adversarial planning team: it spawns 5 members who critique each other's findings, keeps only the insights that survive the attacks, and mandatorily hands them to the 'plan' agent to write the executable plan.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says 'hyperplan', 'hpp', '/hyperplan', or asks for adversarial or cross-critique planning.

say_en.text: Use hyperplan to plan this project.
Run a hostile critique on this plan.
say_en.note: Members attack each other; only defensible points survive.

say_en.text: hpp: check my plan for blind spots and over-engineering.
say_en.note: Findings are handed to the plan agent for a formal plan.
